key_insight: QuantumChain combines hybrid quantum-classical federated learning with encryption, blockchain auditability, and quantum-secure communication to improve fraud detection while preserving privacy and trust.
engineering_relevance: The framework shows how quantum models can be deployed in a practical distributed financial setting without sacrificing federated coordination, security, or convergence stability.
method: Local hybrid quantum-classical neural networks with a variational quantum circuit between classical layers
Encrypted federated aggregation using homomorphic encryption and threshold secret sharing
Permissioned blockchain logging with reputation-weighted trust and QKD-based keying
evidence_signal: On financial transaction data, the HQNN matched classical accuracy while improving fraud-class recall to 94.6% vs 93.2%, and in 10-client federated training global accuracy rose from 97.7% to 98.8% over five rounds.
watch_item: The reported gains depend on simulation-based mixed-state and compact baseline settings, so real hardware noise, encryption overhead, and scalability could affect deployment performance.
paper_title: QuantumChain: Blockchain-Backed Quantum Federated Learning for Financial Fraud Detection
